headline: Clear Expands Football Marketing Strategy to Formula 1 with Red Bull
summary: Clear partnered with Red Bull Racing to bring its sports marketing strategy, combining athletes, special products, and fan activations, to Formula 1.
why: Global sports sponsorships by consumer brands drive consumer engagement, brand visibility, and premium product sales across international markets.

impacts.name: Consumer Goods
impacts.why: Global racing partnerships enhance brand equity and international visibility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
